assumptions: Model is the system as operated at 22:00 on 4 Nov 2006 with LAN coupler open (closed=false); later coupling must be a path change switches.LAN coupler.closed=true, not a model edit.

Reduced network, bus names, line lengths, per-km parameters, transformer rating/impedances, 1.05 pu generator/grid-equivalent voltage setpoints and 100 km south-equivalent line lengths are RECONSTRUCTED values exactly as given on the data sheet (report gives no impedances); no rating was invented or altered.

Documented 22:00 injections are fixed-P gens at DOL (1564 MW), GRO (507 MW) and LAN220 (415 MW), all vm_pu=1.05 per data sheet; SOUTH_E is the reference ext_grid (1.05 pu, 0 deg) and SOUTH_W is an ext_grid at 1.05 pu.

Only unknown tuned was SOUTH_W va_degree, as the data sheet names it the one quantity to calibrate; final value -5.43 degrees gives LAN-WEH 1225.0 MW simulated vs 1225 MW documented. No line, transformer, injection or limit parameter was tuned.
No separate loads are modelled: the data sheet documents only the three injections and the two south grid equivalents, which absorb the balance.

Borken split substation is not in the reduced model per data sheet; Conneforde-Diele (already switched off at 21:38/21:39) is outside the reduced network and its effect is embodied in the documented 22:00 flows/injections.

limits contains one governing check per element in this spec; for LAN-WEH the governing tripping current is the lower end value 2100 A at Wehrendorf (RWE TSO) vs 3000 A at Landesbergen (E.ON Netz), and all other cited Table 1 settings (thermal 2000 A both ends; warnings 1000/2000 A E.ON and 1795 A RWE; maximum accepted 2550 A/1h E.ON and 1995 A RWE) are recorded verbatim in the limits where/source fields. Other lines are checked against their data-sheet thermal ratings (2000 A/circuit at 380 kV, 1000 A at 220 kV) via max_i_ka x parallel.
